procedure_column: Mittlefehldt 2024 Appendix A Pallasite olivine Spot analysis ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Johnson Space Center

Laboratory.cell: ICP-MS Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, Houston TX, USA
Laboratory.value: ICP-MS Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, Houston TX, USA

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Mittlefehldt (2024) GCA; Lee (Rice University) Excel data reduction spreadsheet
Procedure Reference(s).value: Mittlefehldt (2024) GCA; Lee (Rice University) Excel data reduction spreadsheet

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (olivine grain fragment) > Spot — "The laser was run in spot mode with a 75 µm spot size" (p.5); results are reported as average analyses per sample, and individual spots carry labels such as "laser spot 059-Pa-1" (p.8). Line scans across grain fragments were also run (p.3)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts
Sample Preparation Method.value: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: N (grains imaged by SEM to locate inclusion-free regions)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Freedom from inclusions, checked by SEM beforehand — the grains were "low in inclusions, [but] were not devoid of them", so "The grains were first imaged using a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to locate regions for analysis. Regions containing surface inclusions were avoided for analysis" (p.5)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Freedom from inclusions, checked by SEM beforehand

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM imaging of the grain mounts, used to place the spots — "The grains were first imaged using a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to locate regions for analysis. Regions containing surface inclusions were avoided for analysis" (p.5); the grains are the same mounts already used for EMPA (p.5)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM imaging of the grain mounts, used to place the spots

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Excel spreadsheets developed by C.-T. A. Lee (Rice University)
Data Processing Software(s).value: Excel spreadsheets developed by C.-T. A. Lee (Rice University)

Analysis Sequence.cell: BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g measured as calibration standards; Marjalahti as in-session control
Analysis Sequence.value: BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g measured as calibration standards; Marjalahti as in-session control

Target Species.cell: ²⁵Mg, ²⁷Al, ³¹P, ⁴³Ca, ⁴⁴Ca, ⁴⁵Sc, ⁴⁷Ti, ⁴⁹Ti, ⁵¹V, ⁵²Cr, ⁵³Cr, ⁵⁹Co, ⁶⁰Ni, ⁶¹Ni, ⁶²Ni, ⁶⁴Zn, ⁶⁶Zn, ⁶⁹Ga, ⁷¹Ga (19 nuclides)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Trace element concentrations in pallasite olivine (µg/g), reported as average analyses per sample with dispersion, the measured nuclides being "25Mg, 27Al, 31P, 43Ca, 44Ca, 45Sc, 47Ti, 49Ti, 51V" and others (p.5); P2O5 content is estimated where P was not in the protocol ("the P2O5 content was probably ~1.5 wt%", p.3)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: N (parameters lost; 10–50 ms varies by isotope per paper text)

Background Count Time.cell: N (parameters lost; gas blank measured before each analysis per paper text)

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot per location (75 µm circular)

Number of Replicates.cell: N (variable number of spots per sample)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Single element from EPMA: ²⁵Mg; the EMPA data used as the standardizing values

Internal Standard Element.cell: ²⁵Mg (indexing element; Mg concentration from EMPA)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: External calibration using BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g; ²⁵Mg IS from EPMA corrects for ablation yield variation; no explicit downhole fractionation correction described

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn count rates (indicating inclusions or cracks) excluded from integration; manual inspection
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn count rates (indicating inclusions or cracks) excluded from integration; manual inspection

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn excluded (inclusions and heterogeneities); Grubb's test applied to EPMA data for outlier detection
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn excluded (inclusions and heterogeneities); Grubb's test applied to EPMA data for outlier detection

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured before each analysis (laser shutter closed); time steps with background-level signals excluded during data reduction
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured before each analysis (laser shutter closed); time steps with background-level signals excluded during data reduction

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: N (parameters lost; medium resolution mode implies interference resolution by mass)

Interfering Species.cell: N (parameters lost; medium resolution resolves most polyatomic interferences)

Interference Correction Method.cell: Medium mass resolution (M/ΔM ≈ 4000) separates many polyatomic interferences from analyte peaks (e.g., resolves ⁵⁴Fe⁺ from ⁵⁴Cr⁺)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: No post-acquisition normalization; BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g used for calibration; Marjalahti as in-session control

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the reported values are averages per meteorite (Table E4 of the data file), with the complete set of analyses also released (p.6); trace-element chromatograms were "scrutinized for unanticipated interferences, improperly chosen backgrounds or other problems" (p.5). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data. The paper's detailed filters — analysis sums 100 ± 2%, stoichiometry limits, Grubb's test rejecting at p<0.01 and tagging at p<0.05, an FeO ceiling of 17.5 wt% for Phillips County, and a zoning profile excluded from that mean — are stated for the EMPA data (p.3) and are not borrowed here

Combination Method.cell: all: average per sample split; weighted mean per meteorite — 'data averaged per sample split' (Table L2), 'meteorite averages' (Table L3); 'Because a weighted mean is calculated for the data'

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: USGS standard glasses BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, and BIR-1g; preferred values from GeoReM website

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G processed as unknowns alongside samples (same standards as calibration — in-session validation)

value.member: BIR-1G processed as unknowns alongside samples

Detection Limit.cell: N (LODs not stated; concentrations reported for all nuclides above background)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Counting Statistics Error.cell: Theoretical 1 sigma analytical precision from counting statistics plus propagation of uncertainties, ~0.6% on the Fe/Mn ratio of pallasite olivine; the observed standard deviations per meteorite range from 0.6 to 4.0%

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Sc: good agreement with Davis (1977) INAA values within measurement scatter; overall accuracy verified by comparison with literature INAA and SIMS data; Marjalahti used as in-session control (Mn deviation from reference value noted as 4.2% above Ryder 1984)

Additional Notes.cell: Many instrument parameters lost during extended lab shutdown; 75 µm spot size in medium resolution mode on sector-field ICP-MS is unusual combination for olivine trace elements; 25 Mg IS from EPMA is standard approach
Additional Notes.value: Many instrument parameters lost during extended lab shutdown; 75 µm spot size in medium resolution mode on sector-field ICP-MS is unusual combination for olivine trace elements; 25 Mg IS from EPMA is standard approach
